name: OpenChatBI
description: Chat BI agent that links questions to a data catalog, writes SQL for your warehouse and plots the results.
whatItDoes: Lets analysts ask questions of a data warehouse and receive SQL, result tables and Plotly charts. It maintains a catalog of tables and columns to pick the right schema elements.
howItWorks: A LangGraph workflow performs schema linking, SQL generation and execution, then visualisation, with optional MCP tools added through configuration. Settings such as the default LLM provider and warehouse credentials live in a YAML file, and a Streamlit app provides the UI.

requirements.name: LLM provider API key
requirements.description: OpenAI, Anthropic or another supported provider set in config.yaml

models: OpenAI, Anthropic and other configured providers
